##### Project general facts

Palace Residences Hillside Towers A & B is a new benchmark in refined living, where timeless Arabesque sophistication meets the serenity of nature. Surrounded by lush green landscapes and connected to Dubai’s key destinations, the development offers a sense of balance — close to the city yet worlds apart in tranquility. Its contemporary architecture reflects understated grandeur, with soft curves, clean lines, and warm earthy tones inspired by the natural beauty of the hills and horizon.

The residences feature an exclusive collection of one- to three-bedroom branded apartments and townhouses designed for privacy, comfort, and distinction. Each home blends craftsmanship and innovation, with interiors that echo nature’s palette through subtle hues of beige, green, and brown. Floor-to-ceiling windows invite natural light, while luxurious materials and thoughtful detailing create a seamless dialogue between sophistication and calm. Every space is a private sanctuary — elegant, harmonious, and deeply connected to its surroundings.

Palace Residences Hillside Towers A & B offers a world of resort-style amenities, creating a lifestyle of leisure and well-being. Residents can enjoy serene swimming pools, yoga zones, indoor and outdoor gyms, barbecue areas, and dedicated play spaces for children. Landscaped podiums and community spaces encourage connection, while proximity to Dubai Hills Park, Dubai Hills Mall, and the Dubai Hills Golf Club adds an unparalleled layer of convenience and prestige. More than a residence, Palace Residences Hillside is a lifestyle — crafted with the artistry and excellence.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Hills Estate is a prestigious and vibrant master-planned community located in the heart of Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Developed by Emaar Properties in collaboration with Meraas Holding, it represents a harmonious blend of luxury living, natural beauty, and modern urban design. 

At the heart of Dubai Hills Estate is the stunning 18-hole championship golf course, designed to international standards. The golf course adds a touch of greenery and serenity to the landscape, attracting golf enthusiasts from around the world.

Dubai Hills Estate is not just a residential development; it's a comprehensive lifestyle destination. The Dubai Hills Mall, a world-class shopping and entertainment center, offers an array of retail, dining, and entertainment options. Residents and visitors can also enjoy the Central Park, a vast expanse of greenery and relaxation.
